[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-fd[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Timestamped Work Log entries[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every new Work Log entry, from any of Bob's four writers, opens [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with one italic `*YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM*` stamp of the minute it was [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]written. Older date-only entries stay valid and untouched, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]every reader handles both forms the same way.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]2[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/work_log_timestamps.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-fd[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-fd/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob Mac Capture strips both stamp forms[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]mac-strip[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-strip: make the close card's Work Log stripper accept stamped and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]date-only entries strictly, with vector tests and the previews doc, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]before bob starts emitting stamps.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Navigation hotkeys read and write stamps[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]nav-stamp[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]nav-stamp: teach the lane-walk chip to read and show stamps, then stamp [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]every bob-navigation-hotkeys Work Log writer and preview from one [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commit-time clock read per gesture.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob capture close stamps entries and owns the grammar docs[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cli-stamp[dim] · [dim][/dim]after mac-strip, nav-stamp[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cli-stamp: stamp capture `x` close entries from the close's own `now`, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]publish the canonical entry grammar in vault-format.md, refresh the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capture/plan/projects docs, and mark the JSON shape change with `!`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Unlink prompt and Pomodoro checkbox close write stamps[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cycler-stamp[dim] · [dim][/dim]after nav-stamp[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cycler-stamp: stamp block-id-prompt's unlink Work Log and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]task-status-cycler's Pomodoro close entries from one commit-time clock [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]read, replacing the daily-note-filename date.[/#D7D7AF]
